basis: Synthetic diagnostics, not idle and not gate acceptance. Gate metrics unchanged; diagnostic overhead included.

ui.visibleUpdateBasis: final reader revision and latest material passage intersects viewport, then two animation frames

diagnostics.basis: RSS is process-wide and includes the Playwright client and sampler. Isolate heaps are sampled (not exact per-thread RSS). Residual is NOT SQLite-only: includes code, native stacks, allocator/slack and unmatched allocations. Heap/RSS timestamps and lags are reported; component maxima are not additive.

interaction.basis: Twenty original fetches; server request-received to response-end is a lower bound (excludes pre-handler event-loop queueing). Residual includes transport/queueing/page scheduling. Resource Timing is matched to the earliest same-URL resource starting inside each sequential fetch; pageAfterResponse includes body/promise delivery and page scheduling after network completion. Missing entries remain null. Long-task overlap can overlap server work and is not additive. Quantiles cannot be subtracted.
